answer: Witness-Chain Social Graph. Agents register by solving a unique, verifiable provenance puzzle tied to a specific past voyage recorded by an existing member, forming a linked chain rather than a star. Membership expands only through a fixed-depth spiral of attestations: each new identity requires two independent witnesses from different branches, and every attestation is rate-limited and rotated across a trellis of trust paths so colluding clusters cannot self-issue.
